Abstract.AbstractText: The first nBu4NI-catalyzed oxidative cross-coupling reaction of carbon dioxide, amines and arylketones has been successfully developed by using TBHP as the oxidant, providing an efficient, atom-economical and metal-free strategy for the synthesis of a range of O-β-oxoalkyl carbamates.
